goal: Make encodeEvents in src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs reject a non-Uint8Array return from a caller-provided encodeResponseBody or encodeResponseHeader, before any host-facing http.response.start/http.response.body event is sent. Before this package, encodeEvents trusted whatever encodeResponseBody/encodeResponseHeader returned and placed it directly into the outgoing event, so a caller-provided encoder returning a string or object could send a malformed body/header event to send(). This package makes provided encoders accountable for returning bytes, while leaving the internal unencoded profile path (no encoder provided) unchanged.
nonGoals: no new dependency, listener, HTTP/net/fs capability, environment read, clock or randomness use
no change to unencoded (encoder-absent) event shapes, router response mapping, or query_string handling
no attempt to coerce or repair a non-Uint8Array encoder return; it is rejected, not fixed up

scopeResolution.note: Minimal production fix: encodeEvents now runs every encodeResponseBody/encodeResponseHeader return through a checkEncodedBytes(value, label) guard that throws TypeError when the value is not a Uint8Array instance, before the encoded event is constructed or sent. No router, receive, or unencoded-profile logic touched.

red.note: Added four tests: call() and callFromReceive() each with encodeResponseBody returning a plain string/object, and call() and callFromReceive() each with encodeResponseHeader returning a plain (non-encoded) string. Against the pre-fix source these all passed with a malformed body/header event silently reaching send(), instead of rejecting with TypeError before send() was ever called.

green.results: All 40 tests pass, including the four new non-Uint8Array-return rejection assertions and every pre-existing encoder-throw-propagates and unencoded-profile-unchanged assertion. npm run check exits GREEN with no new failures.

acceptance.callRejectsNonBytesBody: call() with encodeResponseBody returning a non-Uint8Array value rejects with TypeError before send() is invoked
acceptance.callFromReceiveRejectsNonBytesBody: callFromReceive() with encodeResponseBody returning a non-Uint8Array value rejects with TypeError before send() is invoked
acceptance.callRejectsNonBytesHeader: call() with encodeResponseHeader returning a non-Uint8Array value rejects with TypeError before send() is invoked
acceptance.callFromReceiveRejectsNonBytesHeader: callFromReceive() with encodeResponseHeader returning a non-Uint8Array value rejects with TypeError before send() is invoked
acceptance.encoderThrowStillPropagates: an encoder that throws still propagates its own error unchanged, as before this package
acceptance.unencodedProfileUnchanged: call()/callFromReceive() without encodeResponseBody/encodeResponseHeader are byte-identical to before this package

rollback.trigger: the added Uint8Array checks are found to reject a legitimate encoder return shape, or any existing test regresses
rollback.action: revert checkEncodedBytes and its two call sites inside encodeEvents in src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs, the added tests, this planning file and the CHANGELOG entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: one function (encodeEvents) inside src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs; no other function or file touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none; no runtime, DB, or I/O surface involved

capabilityDelta: ASGI_ENCODER_RETURN_CONFORMANCE: when a caller provides encodeResponseBody or encodeResponseHeader, the profile boundary now rejects a non-Uint8Array return with TypeError before any host-facing event is sent, instead of forwarding a malformed body/header event to send().

userJourney.once: asgi-core-profile.mjs, encodeEvents caller sağladığı encodeResponseBody/encodeResponseHeader'ın döndürdüğü değeri hiç kontrol etmeden doğrudan giden http.response.start/http.response.body olayına koyuyordu; encoder bir string veya obje döndürürse bu bozuk olay send()'e ulaşabiliyordu.
userJourney.simdi: encodeEvents artık her encodeResponseBody/encodeResponseHeader dönüşünün Uint8Array olmasını şart koşuyor; değilse send() hiç çağrılmadan TypeError fırlatıyor.
userJourney.fark: src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs içinde tek fonksiyonda (encodeEvents) bir doğrulama yardımcı fonksiyonu ve iki kullanım noktası eklendi. Kodlayıcı sağlanmadığında (internal profil modu) davranış hiç değişmedi.
userJourney.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir host adaptörü encodeResponseBody veya encodeResponseHeader sağlar ve bu fonksiyon yanlışlıkla bytes yerine string/obje döndürürse, artık bozuk bir olay host'a gönderilmeden önce TypeError ile durur. Bu paket bir sunucu/host seçmiyor; sadece mevcut çağrılabilir fonksiyonun kodlayıcı dönüş tipini denetliyor.
